turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Happy to help. Please tell me your idea for the tattoo, the size, the placement on your body, and when you are available. I will pass everything to a colleague, who will take it from there. I cannot give a price or a date myself.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I passed your idea (small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, outside of your left forearm, weekday evenings) to a colleague. They will take over and contact you about the booking. I cannot promise a price or a date.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a tattoo. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given to the customer. No order number provided.
